items.headline: What Payment Options Do Customers Expect Today (and Why It Matters)

items.headline: SpotOn Opens Hawaiʻi Technology Showroom to Better Serve Local Restaurant and Hospitality Operators
items.summary_raw: Hawaiʻi restaurant operators finally have a local technology partner. SpotOn opens a new showroom in Kakaʻako district, built to deliver hands-on technology, onboarding, training, and dedicated local support for restaurant operators across the islands.

items.headline: The Cost of Ignoring Reviews:  How AI Helps Restaurants Spot and Fix Customer Issues Fast
items.summary_raw: This blog explores how Pulse by Deliverect helps restaurants detect and address negative restaurant reviews quickly, protect ratings, and keep customers loyal.
